decisions.title: How the data API is built

revisions.choice: Plain Django JSON views under /api/v1 in a new apps/api package that call the existing service functions; no new framework.
revisions.rationale: Every write already goes through service functions with expected revisions; a thin JSON layer reuses them and adds no dependency.

revisions.choice: Plain Django JSON views under /api/v1 in a new apps/api package that call the existing service functions; no new framework.
revisions.rationale: Unchanged choice; the decision now belongs to the backend developer. The frontend builds against it as a working assumption (design engineer, 13 Nov 2026).

decisions.title: Sign-in and session for the frontend

revisions.choice: Same-origin deployment: the Next.js app and /api/v1 are served behind one host; the Django session cookie authenticates; writes send the CSRF token header.
revisions.rationale: C-05 says people sign in once and Django keeps login; same origin avoids CORS and token storage in the browser.
alternatives: Separate origins with CORS and credentials

decisions.title: Where a human task's decision content is read

revisions.choice: PROPOSAL for the backend developer to confirm: each E-WORK-ITEM tasks[] entry gains optional fields: decision (exact version label and number, amount as money that may be unknown, basis, recipient, changes since the previous version, preparer, approval chain with "your step n of m"), cannot_act_reason (not_your_role, prepared_by_you, already_decided, not_your_turn) and asked (who was asked instead, when alerted, by which channel). No new endpoint; the backend composes every value from its records and the line's configured approval order; the frontend shows only what is returned.
revisions.rationale: Smallest change: the decision screen already loads the work item, reuses its read permission and revision, and existing v3 fields and fixtures stay valid because every new field is optional. Unknown amounts use unknown=true with no value, never 0 (INV-UNKNOWN). Approvers and their order come from the backend (D-APPROVAL-ORDER), never from the frontend.
alternatives: New GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id} returning the decision view (separate read permission and handler; a second request per screen)
Extend the E-TASK-CLAIM response (only available after a claim, so not-yours and own-work views would have nothing)

decisions.title: Work item detail the SCR-02 boards show

revisions.choice: PROPOSAL for the backend developer to confirm: E-WORK-ITEM gains optional amount (money, unknown form), started_by and started_at; each station gains optional started_at, finished_at and held_by (who or what holds it, and whether that is you); the agent gains optional started_at and each agent step an optional at.
revisions.rationale: The approved SCR-02 boards show "Started by <person> (<role>) · <date>", station times ("Done · Mon 14:05", "Waiting 2h · you"), agent step times and the agent start time; A-WORKITEM needs an unknown amount. All additions are optional so v3 payloads stay valid.
alternatives: Leave the values off the screen (the readiness fallback)

decisions.title: My work filters and agent marker

revisions.choice: PROPOSAL for the backend developer to confirm: E-WORK-LIST accepts project (a case_id) and waiting_on (me, someone_else, agent, outside_party, no_owner) as optional filters; line takes the line key, never the display title; the response gains optional filters.lines[{key, title}] (lines the person can see work on); rows gain optional line_key and agent (the agent whose avatar the row shows).
revisions.rationale: The approved filter panel (SCR-01-*-filter) offers Line, Project, State and Waiting on, and rows show an agent avatar (CMP-18) when an agent drafted or is working on the item. The waiting_on categories are an engineering proposal read from the board rows, not a business rule. Project options come from E-PROJECTS.
alternatives: Drop the Project and Waiting-on filters from the screen

decisions.title: Payment exception, CEO final costing and CTO emergency decisions
decisions.owner: business owner with the backend developer
decisions.scope: SCR-03 variants: payment exception, CEO costing, CTO emergency

revisions.choice: Not designed. Parked until PSL and the backend developer settle the payment-exception rule: what "Keep owed", "Exception" and "Reject" record, which fields and figures (invoiced, received, owed, rule) each variant returns and sends, who holds the authority, and whether the short payment is decided through E-TASK-DECIDE or an exception action. No verdict, rule or approver is assumed here.
revisions.rationale: A payment exception needs configured human authority and never erases debt (AGENTS.md product invariants); inventing its verdicts would invent a financial rule. The design engineer parked the variants on 13 Nov 2026.
alternatives: Move the short payment to E-WORK-ACTION or E-EXCEPTIONS (FE-M2)

decisions.title: What Start work needs from the contract
decisions.scope: E-LINES, E-LINE-OPTIONS, E-WORK-START, E-EVIDENCE-UPLOAD, E-ME; SCR-04

revisions.choice: PROPOSAL for the backend developer to confirm: (1) each E-LINES line says which case it starts on: case_scope project (the case and its revision come from the chosen option of the field named by case_field) or fixed (case_id and case_revision on the line, e.g. the Finance back-office lines with no Project field); (2) intake[].type takes a defined kind (text, long_text, date, date_range, period, datetime, integer, money, choice, record, records, evidence, display) with help, placeholder, fixed options, depends_on, evidence_kind, display value and restricted; (3) record fields read their options from a new E-LINE-OPTIONS endpoint, filtered by grants on the backend and narrowed by parent; (4) proof is uploaded first with E-EVIDENCE-UPLOAD on the line's case, which now returns the case revision after the upload, and the evidence_id is the intake value; (5) lines carry an optional subtitle, a "what happens next" block (station count, agent, deciding role, summary) and start_via (E-WORK-START, or E-IMPORT for an import line); (6) E-LINES returns default_line for the main button, absent for people whose button opens the menu; (7) /me startable_lines holds line keys; (8) a 422 on E-WORK-START names each field with its message.
revisions.rationale: The approved SCR-04 drawers (16 lines, desktop and phone, plus validation) show choice lists from records, proof files, money and period fields and a "What happens next" block; v5 gives only key, title, group and name/label/type/required, and requires a case revision no read returns. All additions are optional, so v5 payloads stay valid. Field kinds, options, deciding roles and the default line come from the backend; the frontend derives none of them from roles. A blank money value is unknown, never 0 (INV-UNKNOWN). Whether the management accounts drawer starts through E-WORK-START or E-IMPORT, and E-IMPORT's missing entity, basis, extracted-at and control total, are for the backend developer.
alternatives: Options inline in E-LINES (grows with records, cannot filter by parent)
Read project options from E-PROJECTS (no revision, ties Start work to the projects feature)

decisions.title: What Record a response needs from the work item
decisions.scope: E-WORK-ITEM tasks[].response, case_id, case_revision; E-RESPONSE; SCR-16

revisions.choice: PROPOSAL for the backend developer to confirm: E-WORK-ITEM gains optional case_id and case_revision (so proof can be uploaded from the work item) and each task an optional response block: the SCR-16 variant (client response, SOW signature, team input), the responders the backend allows, the actions this task accepts with their labels, the versions being answered, the teams with given or missing input, a blocking sentence, the evidence kind and claim_required. E-RESPONSE gains optional case_revision, version_id, team, estimate_person_days, what, evidence_ids and note. When claim_required is true the frontend calls E-TASK-CLAIM before E-RESPONSE.
revisions.rationale: The approved SCR-16 boards show a who-responded picker, per-variant action choices, a version picker, several proof files and the team-input status; v5 tasks[] carry none of it. Which actions a task accepts and who may have responded are backend business rules, so the contract only carries what the backend allows. For the backend developer: workflows.factory.provide_information requires a factory_information task claimed by the actor, an evidence kind listed in context["missing"] and a case revision, while E-RESPONSE had no claim step and a different action vocabulary; claim_required, evidence_kind and case_revision are proposed to bridge that, and the API maps actions to the backend vocabulary.
alternatives: E-RESPONSE takes the file directly (one write, but no reuse of E-EVIDENCE-UPLOAD)
Frontend lists fixed actions per task kind (a business rule in the frontend)

decisions.title: Which work actions a person may take, and what reconcile shows
decisions.scope: E-WORK-ITEM allowed_actions, reconcile; E-WORK-ACTION; SCR-02 awaiting reconciliation

revisions.choice: PROPOSAL for the backend developer to confirm: E-WORK-ITEM gains optional allowed_actions (resume, cancel, reconcile: what this person may do now, decided by the backend from the line's operator and recovery authority) and a reconcile block (what was sent and when, the agent's checks, the outcomes the backend accepts, the evidence kind and the resend the backend allows after not delivered). The frontend offers an action only when it is listed.
revisions.rationale: The approved SCR-02 awaiting-reconciliation board offers "It arrived / It didn't arrive, allow one resend / I can't tell yet"; a not-delivered answer authorises a resend to a client (INV-RESEND). Offering actions the API did not grant would put recovery authority in the frontend. The resend allowance is stated by the backend; none is assumed here.
alternatives: Try the action and show the 403

decisions.title: Recording an RFP outcome
decisions.scope: New E-RFP-OUTCOME; E-WORK-ITEM rfp_outcome; SCR-16 RFP outcome boards

revisions.choice: PROPOSAL for the backend developer to confirm: a separate POST /api/v1/work/{work_id}/rfp-outcome records won, lost, pending or unknown against one submission, with when it was learned, the role recorded as, proof and a note; optional reason and lessons (lost), awarded amount (won, may be unknown), expected decision date and reminder (pending). E-WORK-ITEM gains an optional rfp_outcome block with the submission, the results, reasons and record-as roles the backend allows, and any outcome already recorded. Lessons map to the backend dispose step.
revisions.rationale: Eight approved SCR-16 states record an RFP outcome; E-RESPONSE's actions cannot carry it and stretching rejected or input would misrecord it. The backend already has pmo.rfp.outcome (submission, result won/lost/pending/unknown, observed_at, role, evidence, note, case revision) and dispose (lessons); reason, awarded amount, expected decision date and reminder have no backend field today and stay optional until the backend developer confirms them. Who may record outcomes is a PSL rule the backend holds ("only roles PSL allows").
alternatives: Leave the RFP outcome states unbuilt

decisions.title: Row shapes for the five project tabs
decisions.scope: E-PROJECT-TAB, E-PROJECT tab counts, E-REPORT sources; SCR-38, SCR-12, SCR-11, SCR-29

revisions.choice: PROPOSAL for the backend developer to confirm: E-PROJECT-TAB rows are typed per tab, in an optional array named by the tab (the untyped v5 items stays and holds the same rows): milestones (position, name, contract amount, completion with proof, invoice, paid, changes with their own amount), documents (document, version, status, test template), money (stage, amount, invoice and its status, paid, the E-REPORT figure that explains it), registers (register, reference, title, severity, owner, state, age; filtered by register and q) and actions (title, from which meeting, owner, due date or unknown, open/overdue/done); a summary carries register and action counts and the money report id. E-PROJECT gains optional revision and tab counts; E-REPORT figures gain an id and source details (document, rule, record, evidence).
revisions.rationale: The approved project tab boards show these columns; v5 rows are untyped ("documented in handoff", never documented). Every amount uses the money form with unknown=true and no value when unknown, never 0, and paid is Finance data separate from the invoice (INV-UNKNOWN, INV-FACTS). Paid status categories and owed amounts are composed by the backend from receipts and allocations, not by the frontend. The documents tab has no approved list board, so its row is an engineering proposal.
alternatives: Keep untyped rows documented in prose

invariants.title: Every record and action is checked by the backend
invariants.rule: Each endpoint resolves the case and calls require(actor, case, action) or the line's authority check before reading or writing; lists filter by grants.

invariants.title: Act only on the current version
invariants.rule: Writes carry expected_revision; a mismatch returns 409 and changes nothing.

invariants.title: Facts are never merged
invariants.rule: Payloads return drafted, reviewed, approved, sent, receipt recorded and verified as separate facts; paid is separate Finance data.

invariants.title: Unknown is not zero
invariants.rule: Amounts and dates that are not known are returned with unknown=true and no value.
invariants.scope: All payloads with amounts or dates

invariants.title: Agents never decide
invariants.rule: Agent runs can draft, read and explain; decision, send and pay endpoints reject agent actors.

invariants.title: Check before resending
invariants.rule: A send with an unknown outcome blocks any new send until reconciled.

invariants.title: History is append-only
invariants.rule: Every write adds an audit event; nothing edits or deletes one.

invariants.title: Payroll rows stay with HR
invariants.rule: Individual payroll rows are returned only to roles with payroll private read; others get totals.

invariants.title: Sample data is labelled
invariants.rule: Records from synthetic or demo cases carry sample=true in every payload.

name.description: Person, role, agent or outside party name as recorded

kind.description: Task kind as named by the backend. A task with a response block is a recorded response (open the response form); one with a decision block is a decision.

label.description: As shown on the board, e.g. "Invoice v2"

amount.description: Amount of the exact version being decided; absent when the decision carries no amount. When the value is not known: unknown=true and no amount, never 0 (INV-UNKNOWN).

basis.description: Plain-language basis composed by the backend from contract terms, e.g. "Contract stage 2 of 4 · terms v1"

recipient.description: Who the output goes to when sent, e.g. a billing email; absent when nothing is sent

person.description: Absent until a person is assigned

decision.description: PROPOSAL (D-TASK-DECISION-VIEW). Present on decision tasks. Every value comes from backend records and the line's configured approval order; the frontend shows only what is returned. your_step is absent when the person has no step.

cannot_act_reason.description: Present only when you_can_act is false

asked.description: Who was asked to act on this task (shown when you cannot act); empty when nobody is assigned yet.

blocking.description: Plain sentence on who holds review, e.g. "Security and Product haven't given input yet."

response.description: PROPOSAL (D-RESPONSE-VIEW): present on tasks a person records for someone who does not log in. Which actions a task accepts and who may have responded are backend rules; the frontend offers only what is listed. claim_required true: call E-TASK-CLAIM before E-RESPONSE.

amount.description: Amount of the work item (e.g. the invoice); absent when the line carries no amount. When the value is not known: unknown=true and no amount, never 0 (INV-UNKNOWN).

case_id.description: Case the work belongs to; the path for E-EVIDENCE-UPLOAD

allowed_actions.description: PROPOSAL (D-WORK-ACTIONS-VIEW): the E-WORK-ACTION actions this person may take now, decided by the backend. Absent or empty: offer none.

what.description: What was sent, e.g. "Invoice INV-0412 v2 to the billing contact"

resend.description: What a not-delivered answer allows, as the backend states it, e.g. "one resend of the same version"

reconcile.description: PROPOSAL (D-WORK-ACTIONS-VIEW): present when the state is awaiting_reconciliation or effect_uncertain.

rfp_outcome.description: PROPOSAL (D-RFP-OUTCOME): present on an RFP when the backend lets this person record its outcome. results, reasons and record_as come from the backend.

type.description: PROPOSAL (D-START-INTAKE): one of text, long_text, date, date_range, period, datetime, integer, money, choice, record, records, evidence, display. The submitted intake value per kind: text/long_text a string; date YYYY-MM-DD; date_range {from, to}; period YYYY-MM; datetime ISO 8601; integer a number; money {amount, currency, unknown} (left blank = unknown=true with no amount, never 0); choice one options[].value; record one option value from E-LINE-OPTIONS; records a list of them; evidence an evidence_id returned by E-EVIDENCE-UPLOAD on the line's case; display is shown, never sent.

help.description: Hint under the field as composed by the backend, e.g. "Only milestones marked complete, with proof, are listed."

options.description: Fixed choices for a choice field (e.g. Audience: Internal or Client), listed by the backend.

options_source.description: Present on record/records fields: read the options from E-LINE-OPTIONS for this line and field

depends_on.description: Name of the field whose value narrows these options (e.g. milestone depends on project); sent as parent to E-LINE-OPTIONS

evidence_kind.description: Kind to send to E-EVIDENCE-UPLOAD for an evidence field

value.description: For display fields: the value shown, e.g. "Client weekly report · test template v1"

subtitle.description: One line under the title in the chooser, e.g. "From a completed milestone"

case_scope.description: project: the case is the project chosen in the intake field named by case_field; fixed: start on case_id below

case_field.description: Name of the record field whose chosen option carries case_id and case_revision (case_scope project)

case_id.description: Case to start on when case_scope is fixed (e.g. the Finance back-office case)

items.description: Role that decides, as configured on the line

next.description: The "What happens next" block. Absent fields are not shown; the frontend derives none of it from roles.

start_via.description: Which endpoint starts the line: E-WORK-START, or E-IMPORT for a file import line

default_line.description: Line key the main Start work button opens directly. Absent: the button opens the menu (e.g. CEO and CTO, D-LEADERS-START).

scenarios.title: Identity and destinations by role
scenarios.given: A PM and a Finance Lead with sample grants
scenarios.then: Each gets only their destinations and startable lines; signed-out gets 401

scenarios.title: Three queues with kinds and counts
scenarios.given: Sample work: one decision, one exception, one waiting, one verified
scenarios.then: Needs me holds Decide/Do/Fix rows only; counts match; sample=true on sample cases; payroll rows never reach a Finance Lead

scenarios.title: Work item shows separate facts and agent steps
scenarios.given: An invoice approved but not sent, amount of a later stage unknown
scenarios.then: Facts approved=earned, sent=not_yet; unknown amount has unknown=true and no value; agent steps carry no approval

scenarios.title: History is complete and read-only
scenarios.given: A work item with a return and an approval
scenarios.then: Every event in order with actor kind; restricted entries say Restricted; no edit endpoint exists

scenarios.title: Approve one exact version
scenarios.given: A Finance Lead eligible for invoice v2, prepared by someone else
scenarios.when: Claim and approve with the current revision
scenarios.then: 200; work moves on; one audit event; an alert is queued; the preparer cannot claim the same task

scenarios.title: Stale version is refused
scenarios.given: Invoice replaced by v3 after the page loaded
scenarios.then: 409; nothing changes; the client shows the newer version

scenarios.title: Start a line
scenarios.given: A PM with factory.start on a project
scenarios.when: Start the weekly report with valid intake
scenarios.then: 201 with work id; missing field returns 422; a line without permission is absent from /lines

scenarios.title: Record a client response with proof
scenarios.given: A task waiting for the client UAT response
scenarios.when: Upload proof, record approved with attestation
scenarios.then: Task completes; evidence hash stored; without proof 422; the form offers only the responders, actions and versions the task returns, and claims first when claim_required

scenarios.title: Reconcile an uncertain send
scenarios.given: A delivery with unknown outcome
scenarios.then: State moves on; no resend happened before reconciliation; only actions in allowed_actions are offered

scenarios.title: Resume after setup
scenarios.given: Work held at setup needed
scenarios.then: Work continues from the held step

scenarios.title: Project journey and money tab
scenarios.given: A project with four stages, one amount unknown
scenarios.then: Unknown stage amount is unknown, not 0; invoices and receipts separate

scenarios.title: Floor counts from visible records
scenarios.given: A PMO Lead with sample work
scenarios.then: Counts match visible work; reduced motion shows the flat view

scenarios.title: Month-end and import
scenarios.given: October with one missing bank statement
scenarios.when: Read month-end; submit a file with a wrong period row
scenarios.then: Cash received shows known amount plus Unknown; import is quarantined with findings

scenarios.title: Payroll rows stay with HR
scenarios.given: HR Lead and Finance Lead
scenarios.then: HR Lead gets rows; Finance Lead gets 403

scenarios.title: Rules are versioned and Not set is explicit
scenarios.given: A Finance rule not set
scenarios.then: Read shows set=false; save creates a new revision; stale revision 409

scenarios.title: Preferences and notification centre
scenarios.given: A person with immediate WhatsApp
scenarios.when: Change to daily email; trigger a decision
scenarios.then: Preference saved; notification listed; mock adapter records the send

scenarios.title: Assistant answers with sources and drafts
scenarios.given: A Finance user and a restricted payroll record
scenarios.when: Ask about a project; ask for payroll figures; ask for an invoice draft
scenarios.then: Answer cites records; payroll: cannot answer, says why; draft links to a started line, not approved

scenarios.title: Report figures link to records
scenarios.given: Monthly report with an unknown figure
scenarios.then: Each figure lists its sources; unknown is unknown

scenarios.title: Why a person cannot act, and who was asked instead
scenarios.given: Invoice v2 waiting for a Finance Lead: a Finance user, its preparer, the Finance Lead after approving, and a CEO before the PMO Lead has approved a costing
scenarios.then: Each gets you_can_act=false with cannot_act_reason not_your_role, prepared_by_you, already_decided or not_your_turn and the people asked; the eligible Finance Lead gets the decision view with version, amount (unknown=true and no value when unknown, never 0), basis, recipient, changes and chain with your_step; values come from records, none from the frontend

scenarios.title: Payment exception, CEO final costing and CTO emergency decisions
scenarios.given: D-DECISION-VARIANTS settled by PSL and the backend developer
scenarios.then: Defined when D-DECISION-VARIANTS is decided; no verdict, rule or approver is assumed before then

scenarios.title: Frontend meets devices and WCAG 2.2 AA
scenarios.given: The first feature built
scenarios.when: Run automated accessibility checks and test on phone and desktop
scenarios.then: No AA violations; focus ring and reduced motion work; layouts at 390px and 1440px

scenarios.title: Start work drawers are built from what the backend returns
scenarios.given: A PM with factory.start on two projects, a Finance user with the back-office lines, a CEO, and a milestone that is not complete
scenarios.when: Each opens Start work, chooses a line and fills its intake
scenarios.then: Fields render by their defined kind; record options come from E-LINE-OPTIONS filtered by grants and narrowed by the parent field; the case and its revision come from the chosen project or the line's fixed case; proof is uploaded first and sent as an evidence_id; a blank money value is sent as unknown, never 0; the CEO's main button opens the menu because no default_line is returned; a 422 names each field

scenarios.title: Record an RFP outcome against one submission
scenarios.given: A submitted RFP whose work item returns rfp_outcome, and a person not among the record_as roles
scenarios.when: Record won with the award letter; record lost with reason and lessons; record pending; the other person opens the RFP
scenarios.then: Each is stored once with its proof and the role recorded as; an unknown awarded amount stays unknown; lost lessons are kept; the person not allowed sees no outcome form (no rfp_outcome block); a stale revision returns 409

scenarios.title: Project tabs show typed rows with separate facts
scenarios.given: A project with four milestones (one amount unknown, one change with unknown amount), registers, documents and nine actions (three overdue, one without owner)
scenarios.then: Rows match their tab's shape; unknown amounts have unknown=true and no value; completion, invoice and paid are separate; register filter and search narrow rows; action summary counts match the rows; tab counts match E-PROJECT
